evidence: The structural properties were analyzed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and the morphology was studied by means of an atomic force microscope (AFM). The residual C content in the films was measured by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The deposition rates of the constituent elements and the film composition, as well as the film thickness, were calculated using wavelength dispersive X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF).
